## Prevent Potion Cloud

---

[Power Type](https://github.com/Provismet/Provi-Origins/wiki/Power-Types)

Prevents the entity from being affected by potion clouds. This includes splash potions and lingering potions.

Type ID: `proviorigins:prevent_potion_cloud`

## Fields

---

## Examples
```json
{
    "type": "proviorigins:prevent_potion_cloud"
}
```
